title: Spring 2026
summary: Three months of planting turned into a family that holds together on the page — the story is still to come.

scenes.prose: Spring's whole job was arrival: a father, a mother, four kits, and the forest they stand in.

asset.alt: A wood-brown branch with three buds, marking the whole family's arrival across the season.

scenes.prose: Nothing about The Kits is written yet — but everyone in it now has a face.

asset.alt: A four-petal blush blossom with a mint centre, marking the family's design settling in.

scenes.prose: The resemblance between the artist personas and the characters they made is on purpose. The reason is still theirs to tell.

asset.alt: A pale-mint sprout, marking a detail deliberately held for later.

scenes.prose: Next season's job: give this family something to walk toward.

asset.alt: A sage-green leaf, marking the season closing on an open question.
